title: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways
authors: A. Chowdhery, S. Narang, J. Devlin, et al. (67 authors)
before: Reasoning gains from scale looked modest and uneven.
problem: Would more scale actually help on tasks requiring multi-step inference?
breakthrough: 540B dense parameters trained across TPU pods, reaching breakthrough results on reasoning benchmarks with chain-of-thought prompting.
why: It supplied the strongest evidence for the scale-unlocks-reasoning story, and the discontinuities that fed the emergence debate.
next: Flan-PaLM instruction-tuned it; Gemini succeeded it.
inherits: The pairing of large scale with chain-of-thought as the reasoning recipe of 2022.
